title: Suzuka Circuit ni bustani ya burudani, lakini wafanyakazi wanaonekana kama wahandisi
label: Wafanyakazi kama wahandisi

text.Suzuka Circuit is also an amusement park: Suzuka Circuit pia ni bustani ya burudani.
text.So there are many amusement park rides t: Kwa hiyo kuna michezo mingi ya bustani ya burudani pia.
text.But is it totally an amusement park? It: Lakini je, ni bustani ya burudani kabisa? Kuna tofauti kidogo.
text.For example, Universal Studios Japan or: Kwa mfano, Universal Studios Japan au Tokyo Disneyland.
text.There, when you pass the staff, they wel: Ukipita karibu na wafanyakazi huko, wanakukaribisha katika ulimwengu wa Disney au Universal, sivyo?
text.But it is a car-related place, so even w: Lakini hapa panahusiana na magari, kwa hiyo ukiwapita wafanyakazi hali ni kama kusema, “Kazi nzuri, rafiki.”
text.That slightly stiff and awkward feeling: Hali hiyo ya kuwa na ugumu na aibu kidogo ilinivutia.
text.It is an amusement park, but it felt lik: Ni bustani ya burudani, lakini nilihisi, “Ndiyo, inaeleweka.”
text.Somehow, I remember that it was interest: Sijui kwa nini, lakini bado nakumbuka kuwa jambo hilo lilivutia.
